newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Statistics NZ appoints CPI revision advisory cmtte.
newsitem.headline: Statistics NZ appoints CPI revision advisory cmtte.

text.p: Statistics New Zealand on Friday announced membership of the committee to advise on the five-yearly revision of the Consumers Price Index.
Government departments and public sector organisations represented on the committee are David Grimmond (the Treasury) and Scott Roger (Reserve Bank of New Zealand).
Representation from Social Welfare, the Ministries of Commerce/Consumer Affairs and the Bankers Association are still to be decided.

From the private sector and community groups, members include David Russell (Consumers Institute), Peter Harris (Council of Trade Unions), Jeremy Harding (Federated Farmers), Peter Crawford (Manufacturers Federation), John Pask (Employers Federation), John Albertson (Retail and Wholesale Merchants Association) and Suzanne Snively, consulting economist.
